genshin-impact.name: Genshin Impact
genshin-impact.intro: Genshin Impact is HoYoverse's open-world action RPG. Players explore the world of Teyvat, collect characters through a gacha system, and battle using elemental combat.
redeemSteps: Open Genshin Impact and reach Adventure Rank 10
Go to Settings > Account > Redeem Code
Paste or type the code exactly as shown
Check your in-game mail for rewards

honkai-star-rail.name: Honkai: Star Rail
honkai-star-rail.intro: Honkai: Star Rail is a turn-based space-fantasy RPG by HoYoverse. Build your team across the galaxy with strategic combat and stunning visuals.
redeemSteps: Open Honkai: Star Rail and complete the tutorial (Trailblaze Level 10)
Rewards arrive via in-game mail within minutes

wuthering-waves.name: Wuthering Waves
wuthering-waves.intro: Wuthering Waves is a post-apocalyptic open-world ARPG by Kuro Games. Battle the Tacet Discords with fluid combat and explore the world of Solaris-3.
redeemSteps: Open Wuthering Waves and reach Union Level 22
Go to Settings > Other > Redeem Code

zenless-zone-zero.name: Zenless Zone Zero
zenless-zone-zero.intro: Zenless Zone Zero is HoYoverse's stylish urban-fantasy action RPG. Fight Ethereals in the city of New Eridu with fast-paced combo combat.
redeemSteps: Open Zenless Zone Zero and reach Inter-Knot Level 8
Open the menu (ESC on PC, gear icon on mobile)

free-fire.name: Garena Free Fire
free-fire.intro: Garena Free Fire is a fast-paced mobile battle royale. Drop into a 10-minute match with 49 other players and fight to be the last one standing.
redeemSteps: Log in with your Free Fire account (Facebook/Google/VK/etc.)
Rewards arrive in-game within 24 hours via mail

mobile-legends.name: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang
mobile-legends.intro: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang is a 5v5 MOBA by Moonton. Pick from 100+ heroes and battle in 10-minute matches with classic MOBA gameplay.
redeemSteps: Enter your ML User ID and Server ID (find them in-game Profile)
Enter the verification code sent to your in-game mail

pubg-mobile.name: PUBG Mobile
pubg-mobile.intro: PUBG Mobile is the mobile version of the original battle royale. 100 players, one shrinking map, last team standing.
redeemSteps: Enter your PUBG Mobile Character ID (found in Profile)

roblox-blox-fruits.name: Blox Fruits (Roblox)
roblox-blox-fruits.intro: Blox Fruits is one of the most popular Roblox games, inspired by One Piece. Eat devil fruits, master sword & gun combat, and become the strongest pirate.
redeemSteps: Click the Settings cog icon on the left side of the screen
Scroll down to find the Redeem Code box
Click Redeem to claim the reward

afk-journey.name: AFK Journey
afk-journey.intro: AFK Journey is the successor to AFK Arena by Lilith Games. Idle RPG with strategic team building, gorgeous art, and consistent rewards.
redeemSteps: Tap Confirm — rewards via in-game mail

clash-of-clans.name: Clash of Clans
clash-of-clans.intro: Clash of Clans is Supercell's iconic strategy game. Build your village, train troops, and battle in Clan Wars across millions of players worldwide.
